cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.18)
project(ijkplayer_native LANGUAGES C CXX)

# Reuse the exact upstream source lists rather than maintaining another list for
# player, SDL, JNI bindings or SoundTouch. Sources are pinned by the Node recipe.
function(ijk_sources output directory)
    file(STRINGS "${directory}/Android.mk" entries REGEX "^LOCAL_SRC_FILES[ \t]+\\+=[ \t]+[^ \\]+$")
    set(result)
    foreach(entry IN LISTS entries)
        string(REGEX REPLACE "^LOCAL_SRC_FILES[ \t]+\\+=[ \t]+" "" entry "${entry}")
        list(APPEND result "${directory}/${entry}")
    endforeach()
    if(NOT result)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "No upstream source list in ${directory}/Android.mk")
    endif()
    set(${output} ${result} PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()

set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 99)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS "${CMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS} -Wl,-z,max-page-size=16384 -Wl,--no-undefined")
add_compile_definitions(ANDROID NDEBUG)
set(media "${IJK_SOURCE}/ijkmedia")
set(generated "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/include")
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${generated}/libffmpeg" "${generated}/ijksoundtouch")
configure_file("${FFMPEG_BUILD}/config.h" "${generated}/libffmpeg/config.h" COPYONLY)
configure_file("${SOUNDTOUCH_SOURCE}/ijksoundtouch_wrap.h" "${generated}/ijksoundtouch/ijksoundtouch_wrap.h" COPYONLY)
file(WRITE "${generated}/ijkversion.h" "#ifndef IJKVERSION_H\n#define IJKVERSION_H\n#define IJKPLAYER_VERSION \"k0.8.8\"\n#endif\n")
include_directories("${generated}" "${media}" "${media}/ijksdl" "${media}/ijkj4a" "${FFMPEG_BUILD}" "${FFMPEG_SOURCE}")

add_library(ijkffmpeg SHARED IMPORTED)
set_target_properties(ijkffmpeg PROPERTIES IMPORTED_LOCATION "${FFMPEG_BUILD}/libijkffmpeg.so")
add_library(cpufeatures STATIC "${ANDROID_NDK}/sources/android/cpufeatures/cpu-features.c")
target_include_directories(cpufeatures PUBLIC "${ANDROID_NDK}/sources/android/cpufeatures")

# Match the Android.mk base and ABI-specific pixel conversion sources. The old
# upstream CMake file unconditionally builds host tools and misses arm64 NEON.
file(READ "${LIBYUV_SOURCE}/Android.mk" yuv_make)
string(FIND "${yuv_make}" "# TODO" yuv_end)
string(SUBSTRING "${yuv_make}" 0 ${yuv_end} yuv_base)
string(REGEX MATCHALL "source/[A-Za-z0-9_]+\\.cc" yuv_names "${yuv_base}")
if(ANDROID_ABI STREQUAL "armeabi-v7a")
    list(APPEND yuv_names source/compare_neon.cc source/rotate_neon.cc source/row_neon.cc source/scale_neon.cc)
elseif(ANDROID_ABI STREQUAL "arm64-v8a")
    list(APPEND yuv_names source/compare_neon64.cc source/rotate_neon64.cc source/row_neon64.cc source/scale_neon64.cc)
endif()
list(TRANSFORM yuv_names PREPEND "${LIBYUV_SOURCE}/")
add_library(yuv STATIC ${yuv_names})
target_include_directories(yuv PUBLIC "${LIBYUV_SOURCE}/include")
if(ANDROID_ABI MATCHES "^(armeabi-v7a|arm64-v8a)$")
    target_compile_definitions(yuv PRIVATE LIBYUV_NEON)
endif()

ijk_sources(j4a_sources "${media}/ijkj4a")
add_library(ijkj4a STATIC ${j4a_sources})
target_link_libraries(ijkj4a PUBLIC log)
ijk_sources(soundtouch_sources "${SOUNDTOUCH_SOURCE}")
add_library(ijksoundtouch STATIC ${soundtouch_sources})
target_include_directories(ijksoundtouch PUBLIC "${SOUNDTOUCH_SOURCE}" "${SOUNDTOUCH_SOURCE}/include")
target_link_libraries(ijksoundtouch PUBLIC cpufeatures log)

ijk_sources(sdl_sources "${media}/ijksdl")
add_library(ijksdl SHARED ${sdl_sources})
target_link_libraries(ijksdl PRIVATE ijkffmpeg ijkj4a cpufeatures yuv log android OpenSLES EGL GLESv2)
ijk_sources(player_sources "${media}/ijkplayer")
add_library(ijkplayer SHARED ${player_sources} "${IJK_SOURCE}/ijkprof/android-ndk-profiler-dummy/jni/prof.c"
    bitmap_subtitles.c bitmap_subtitle_pixels.c playback_soundtouch.cpp)
target_include_directories(ijkplayer PRIVATE "${media}/ijkplayer" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
target_include_directories(ijkplayer PRIVATE "${SOUNDTOUCH_SOURCE}/include")
target_link_libraries(ijkplayer PRIVATE ijkffmpeg ijksdl ijksoundtouch log android jnigraphics)
